gender_policy.defect_resolution_note: Prevents Artefact 2 defect where story-builder fallback defaulted to Kore (female voice). All fallbacks are strictly verified male archetypes.

intimacy_and_pacing_policy.whisper_guideline: Use intimate close-proximity phonation with low pitch and warm vocal fry. Do NOT collapse into unvoiced breathy white-noise whispering.
intimacy_and_pacing_policy.state_isolation: Reset stateful session parameters between scenes to prevent intimate/bedroom delivery styles from carrying over into daytime/outdoor scenes.
intimacy_and_pacing_policy.timbre_matching: Maintain consistent vocal identity across scene transitions; adjust projection level while keeping fundamental frequency and vocal resonance matched.

archetypes.name: Rugged / Dominant Lead
archetypes.personality: Protective, experienced, grounded, authoritative yet deeply tender in private intimacy.
archetypes.acoustic_profile: Deep baritone / bass, low-end vocal resonance, heavy glottal airflow, proximity effect bass boost.
archetypes.delivery_style: Slow, measured cadence, quiet strength, minimal projection in close scenes.

archetypes.name: Vulnerable / Soft Partner
archetypes.personality: Yielding, emotional, sensitive, overwhelmed with sensation, hesitant yet deeply trusting.
archetypes.acoustic_profile: Soft tenor, high glottal flow, breathy vocal texture, velvet intimacy, micro-tremors on climax.
archetypes.delivery_style: Close proximity (in-ear), gentle airflow, hesitations broken by short pauses, emotional vulnerability.

archetypes.name: Energetic / Playful Athletic
archetypes.personality: Confident, teasing, boyish, casual banter, switches from cheeky cockiness to breathless awe.
archetypes.acoustic_profile: Bright, clear modern slang cadence, mid-range projection, vocal smile.
archetypes.delivery_style: Fluid conversational pace, teasing laughter, slightly faster delivery in casual banter, dropping low in bedroom.

archetypes.name: Warm / Comforting Roommate or Caregiver
archetypes.personality: Reassuring, soothing, steady, empathetic, patient, perfect for emotional climaxes and aftercare.
archetypes.acoustic_profile: Warm, relaxed, velvety, smooth mid-frequencies, rhythmic breathing pattern.
archetypes.delivery_style: Slow comforting cadence, warm smile in voice, soothing reassurance.

archetypes.name: Intimate First-Person Narrator (Protagonist Interiority)
archetypes.personality: Confessional, direct-to-listener, vulnerable thoughts, interior monologue during intimate moments.
archetypes.acoustic_profile: Treated as protagonist's voice inside the listener's head; warm, intimate, zero theatrical bombast.
archetypes.delivery_style: Conversational, unhurried, reflecting real-time physical sensations, NOT third-person objective.
